backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the VVCEBAJA app defining data types (Person, Achievement, Event, LockerBill, etc.) and persistent maps, with access control, blob storage mixins, and user approval logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that Layout.tsx implements a conditionally rendered 'Admin Panel' navigation link for admin users in both desktop and mobile menus, navigating to the /admin route.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a reference index for the project's React components, pages, hooks, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS entry point applying Tailwind directives and defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including sidebar, chart, and UI element variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell with the page title set to 'VVCEBAJA' and a root div that mounts the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with all application routes, wraps the app in ThemeProvider and QueryClientProvider, and renders the Toaster notification component.
Card component that displays an achievement's image, title, date, and description, with an admin-only delete button that calls the removeAchievement mutation.
frontend/src/components/AddAchievementMo: Modal form for adding a new achievement with title, date, description, and optional multi-image upload with progress tracking, using the addAchievement mutation on submit.
frontend/src/components/AddBillModal.tsx: Modal dialog component for uploading a bill with fields for title, amount, date, comments, and an image file, using the useAddBill hook and ExternalBlob for file upload with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/AddDocumentModal: Modal dialog component for uploading a document with title, description, tags, and file fields, using the useAddDocument hook and ExternalBlob for file upload with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/AddDriveLinkModa: Modal dialog component for adding a drive link with title, URL, and description fields, using the useAddDriveLink hook with URL validation before submission.
frontend/src/components/AddEquipmentModa: Modal dialog component for adding equipment with fields for name, quantity, unit price, purchase date, description, comments, and an image, using the useAddEquipment hook and ExternalBlob for image upload.
frontend/src/components/AddEventModal.ts: Modal dialog component for adding an event with title, date, location, description, and optional multiple image uploads, using the useAddEvent hook and ExternalBlob for image handling.
frontend/src/components/AddPhotoModal.ts: Modal dialog for uploading one or more photo files to the locker, with upload progress tracking and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AddTeamMemberMod: Modal dialog for adding a new team member with fields for name, Principal ID, role, contact info, and profile image upload.
frontend/src/components/BillCard.tsx: Card component displaying a locker bill's image, amount, date, and author, with download and admin-only delete actions.
frontend/src/components/DocumentCard.tsx: Card component displaying a locker document's metadata and tags, with download and admin-only delete actions.
frontend/src/components/DriveLinkCard.ts: Card component displaying a drive link's title, description, and date, with an open-link button and admin-only delete action.
frontend/src/components/EquipmentCard.ts: Card component displaying an equipment item's image, quantity, unit price, purchase date, and description, with an admin-only delete button.
frontend/src/components/EventCard.tsx: Card component displaying an event's date, title, location, description, and optional image, with an admin-only delete button for upcoming events.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout component with a sticky header containing navigation links, login/logout handling via Internet Identity, admin link visibility, mobile menu, and an overflow dropdown menu.
frontend/src/components/LockerAccessGate: Access control wrapper that conditionally renders children based on authentication status, admin role, or locker access approval, and allows unapproved users to submit an access request.
frontend/src/components/LockerAccessRequ: Admin panel component that lists locker access requests grouped by pending and decided status, with approve and deny actions for each request.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Simple login/logout button component that uses Internet Identity authentication and clears the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/PhotoGallery.tsx: Displays a responsive grid of photo thumbnails sorted by upload date, opening a lightbox on click.
frontend/src/components/PhotoLightbox.ts: Full-screen lightbox overlay for viewing photos with keyboard navigation, download, and admin-only delete functionality.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts newly authenticated users without a profile to enter their name, then saves the profile via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/ProtectedRoute.t: Route guard component that shows a loading spinner while initializing and an access-denied prompt with a login button for unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/components/TeamMemberCard.t: Displays a team member's card with their image, name, role, and contact info, and shows a delete button for admins that calls the remove person mutation with a confirmation prompt.
frontend/src/components/UpcomingEventsPr: Fetches all events and renders the next 3 upcoming events sorted by date, showing date, title, description, and location with a link to the full events page.
frontend/src/hooks/useAchievements.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching, adding, updating, and removing achievements via the backend actor, invalidating the 'achievements' cache on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor instance using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) access, and invalidates all dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useEvents.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching, adding, updating, and removing events via the backend actor, invalidating the 'events' cache on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useFeedback.ts: Provides hooks for submitting feedback and fetching all feedback entries, with the fetch query gated on actor and identity initialization state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login, logout, identity, and status state to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerAccess.ts: Provides hooks to query a user's locker access request status, check if access is granted, and submit a new locker access request, gracefully handling unauthorized and missing-request errors.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerAccessReques: Provides admin-facing hooks to list all locker access requests and approve or deny individual requests by principal, invalidating the requests cache on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerBills.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching, adding, and deleting locker bills via the backend actor, invalidating the 'bills' cache on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerDocuments.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching, adding, and deleting locker documents via the backend actor, invalidating the 'documents' cache on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerDriveLinks.t: Provides React Query hooks for fetching, adding, and deleting drive links via the backend actor, invalidating the 'driveLinks' cache on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerEquipment.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching, adding, and deleting equipment items via the backend actor, invalidating the 'equipment' cache on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Consolidated React Query hooks for admin check, user profile, team members, and other backend data fetching/mutation operations, with identity-aware query keys and loading state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useTeamMembers.ts: React Query hooks for CRUD operations on team members (people), including fetching all people and adding, updating, or removing a person via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and saving the caller's user profile via the backend actor, with loading state derived from both actor and query status.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including motorsports-inspired color tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: Static About page describing the BAJA Club, featuring a hero banner, animated fade-in paragraphs, and a domain highlights section.
frontend/src/pages/AboutTeam.tsx: Team members page that displays all people in a grid with admin controls to add or manage members via modals.
frontend/src/pages/Achievements.tsx: Achievements page that lists sorted achievements in a grid and allows admins to add new achievements via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin-only panel with access control checks that displays tabs for managing locker access requests and reviewing member feedback.
frontend/src/pages/Events.tsx: Displays a list of upcoming and past events fetched via hook, with sorting by date and an admin-only button to open an AddEventModal for creating new events.
frontend/src/pages/Feedback.tsx: Renders a feedback form with category selection and message input, submitting via a mutation hook, and shows a success state or error message; requires authentication to submit.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page featuring a hero image section with CTAs and a grid of navigation cards linking to major site sections like About, Team, Achievements, Events, and Member Locker.
frontend/src/pages/LockerAccessAdmin.tsx: Admin-only page that guards access by checking authentication and admin status, then renders the LockerAccessRequestsPanel for managing member locker access requests.
frontend/src/pages/LockerBills.tsx: Member-gated page that lists financial bills sorted by date, with an admin button to open AddBillModal for uploading new bills.
frontend/src/pages/LockerDocuments.tsx: Member-gated page displaying team documents with search/filter functionality, sorted by upload date, and an upload button that opens AddDocumentModal.
frontend/src/pages/LockerDriveLinks.tsx: Page component for displaying and managing external drive links in the Member Locker, showing a sorted grid of DriveLinkCards with an option to add new links via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/LockerEquipment.tsx: Page component for the Member Locker's equipment inventory, displaying purchased equipment sorted by date in a grid with an add-equipment modal.
frontend/src/pages/LockerPhotos.tsx: Page component that filters locker documents tagged as photos/images and displays them in a PhotoGallery, with an upload modal for adding new photos.
frontend/src/pages/MemberLocker.tsx: Landing page for the Member Locker that renders navigation cards to all locker sub-sections (Bills, Equipment, Documents, Photos, Drive Links) and conditionally shows an admin-only Access Requests card.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Static settings page displaying placeholder cards for Profile, Notifications, Privacy & Security, and Appearance sections, with a note that full settings management is coming soon.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, persist them in sessionStorage, and clean sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based color tokens (racing-red, carbon-black, metallic-silver, etc.), container settings, border radii, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks project state for a fix request targeting a missing Admin Panel navigation link in Layout.tsx, including known issues, existing features, and schema metadata.
